meta.name: The Crime
meta.description: Set in the 70's, A middle-aged man, Adel is raised by his strict grandfather who he was deeply inspired by.  he met his first love, Nadia who later became his wife and the mother of his son. After this, a chain of events lead to Adel committing many crimes, which are investigated by Amgad Al Husseiny and later, a series of surprises are revealed.
